remarks: Convenient to town, charming and updated 4 bedroom home on a cul de sac just in time for the start of the school year. Open kitchen, lots of flexible space with a porch/office off the living room and workshop space in the garage. Newer windows, updated kitchen and baths, hardwood floors, efficient furnace, new appliances, newer roof and lots of storage. Outside is a lovely new deck for grilling and entertaining, a koi pond and a little cabin that could be used as a playhouse, extra storage or a party barn. Owners prefer to leave the home furnished but could be flexible.
